entries.en: The archive includes plans to immunize cattle against disease.
entries.zh: 档案中收有使牛对疾病产生免疫力的计划。

entries.en: Their polite conversation was a charade hiding mutual distrust.
entries.zh: 他们客气的交谈只是一种伪装，掩盖着彼此的不信任。

entries.en: The biography charts her rise to eminence in astronomy.
entries.zh: 这部传记记述了她在天文学界获得显赫地位的历程。

entries.en: The hikers shared their meager supply of chocolate.
entries.zh: 徒步者们分吃了他们那点少得可怜的巧克力。

entries.en: We made little headway until the missing plans arrived.
entries.zh: 在缺失的图纸送来之前，我们几乎没取得什么进展。
